title: Earlier runner qualification established measurement safeguards, not policy value
summary: The earlier suite exercised smoke, screen, confirmation and operational runs, plus real timeout, cancellation and failed-start controls. Offline verification checked retained identities and aggregates.
scope: Selected runs covered 608 normal completions across eighteen servers, with separate disconnect and warmup/recovery probes; eleven successful/failure-control records covered 879 artifacts.
limitations: Cached-host turnaround is not cold-install cost. Synthetic pressure cases and public-input cases had different activity requirements. The old runner and GPU reservation design are not imported here.
decision: Carry forward the lessons: prove activity, preserve failed attempts, distinguish synthetic diagnostics from live workflows, and verify cleanup and outputs. Design the new benchmark runner later.
